issue.title: 5.0.0 rc.1: AOT compiler creates module factories outside oudir

## I'm submitting a...

## Current behavior `ngc` creates folders for each angular module i.e. router, forms, common right in the project root instead of `outDir`. ![screenshot](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3826972/31285594-660427f2-aac4-11e7-97ae-a2031bb00c72.png) ## Expected behavior Should create files in `outDir` or not create at all. ## Environment

For Tooling issues:
- Node version: 8.4.0

- Platform:   Windows

body: @theodorejb I just tried this with rc.1, and all files go into `compiled_ts` folder. Which TypeScript version are you using? It should be 2.4.x...
Could you create a branch on Github where I can reproduce the problem?

@Matju-M I just tried to also emit `.metadata.json` files, and that worked as well (I took the above `tsconfig.json` and removed the entry for `skipMetadataEmit`). Could you also create a branch to reproduce this?

@tbosch Here's a skeleton project to highlight my issue.
https://github.com/Matju-M/mang-ngx-ui-skeleton.git

My tsconfig.json

```
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "es5",
    "outDir": "aot",
    "moduleResolution": "node",
    "sourceMap": true,
    "emitDecoratorMetadata": true,
    "experimentalDecorators": true,
    "lib": ["es2015", "dom"],
    "noImplicitAny": true,
    "suppressImplicitAnyIndexErrors": true
  },

  "include": ["app/**/*.ts"],

  "angularCompilerOptions": {
    "skipMetadataEmit" : true
  }
}
```
Project is located in `D:\Web\ng5`

Ngc produces folders in the project root `D:\Web\ng5` for common, forms, platform-browser, and router, containing ngsummary.json files and also typescript and rxjs folders in `D:\Web` path

Here is reproduction

![2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4223314/31295511-d87ea430-aaef-11e7-9935-be8f6be09c8f.gif)

_Platform:  Windows
Angular 5.0.0-rc.1_
